name: notify-words
title: Notifications name no cat but a Cattain's own question; a crew thread finishing posts nothing
about: miso starts one crew thread, Fix login, and waits on it. The crew thread finishes: its Cattain hears it, so nothing is posted for it. miso is woken, rewrites its digest and tags the person with ask_person. That posts once, "miso asks" with the question as its body and a reply field: the one notification that names a cat. Read from the app's notification log (headless: nothing reaches the system).

steps.text: Fix the login test [fake:mcp] mcp neko start_crew_thread {"title":"Fix login","brief":"Fix the login test [fake:work:3]"}

sh.run: /usr/bin/sqlite3 "$data/neko.sqlite3" "SELECT status FROM tasks WHERE title = 'Fix login'"

steps.expect: The crew thread ran and finished
miso was woken by its crew and tagged the person: "miso asks", the question, a reply field
Nothing was posted for the crew thread finishing (miso heard it), and miso's question was posted once: the only notification

steps.name: miso-asks
steps.expect: miso's thread ends on its question; the notification log has "miso asks" alone
